abstract: Trace LLM apps with OpenLLMetry (traceloop-sdk), the Apache-2.0 OpenTelemetry instrumentation library. Covers install and TRACELOOP_* configuration, sending spans to Phoenix, Langfuse, MLflow, Jaeger or a Collector, self-hosted OpenAI-compatible engines, LiteLLM and vLLM, content capture, redaction and sampling, upgrades and troubleshooting, with a read-only check script.
